thread:
Jordan K.: heads-up: vendor sent over a config bundle that accidentally contained oauth client secrets for several internal svc-* apps. they rotated their copy but asked us to rotate ours as precaution.

Priya S.: Any proof of access? or just their report?

Jordan K.: We have screenshots showing secrets present in the archive. No suspicious activity in logs so far. Treat as high risk.

Nina R.: Proposed immediate actions: rotate affected client secrets, revoke tokens, add artifact scan to CI, and notify CS for possible partner impact.

Sam V.: infra will run an automated rotation job. batching to avoid token-thrash. ETA ~2h for bulk rotation.

infra-ops: kicked off job R-rot-2026-03-23-01, rotating clients in groups of 50 with 30s gap.

security-bot: classification: HIGH. Ticket SEC-1249 opened.

Priya S.: I'll draft partner-facing note in case they see 401s; CS playbook ready.

Nina R.: Quick CI mitigation: block pipelines that include `secrets/` paths in artifacts and delete matching artifacts. Patch to CI scheduled for tomorrow morning.

Sam V.: After rotate we'll invalidate tokens. plan is zero-downtime for most services; for real-time critical flows we'll coordinate owners before rotating.

infra-ops: first batch done, no 401 spike. continuing.

security-bot: rotation complete: 320/320 clients rotated. starting post-rotation audit for anomalous token use (48h lookback).

Jordan K.: Thanks all. Next steps: complete audit, merge CI guard, add artifact secret scanner. Priya will post CS note if partners see issues.

Priya S.: Will post to #customer-success with reconnect steps if needed.

Sam V.: If anyone observes persistent 401s after rotation ping infra-ops and we'll roll back for affected app until owner patches.
